name: CAM_BLEND_694
formula: xmm7 *= 1-(1-[rsi+0x694])^e. State recurrence of +0x698: while the transition timer runs (+0x734>0 or +0x73c) and +0x690!=0, rate = r698 + (target - r698)*k694 once per call (k694 defaults to 0.01), stored at 0x14073b9c6. Carried over unchanged from the previous proposal.

name: CAM_BLEND_A_FINAL
formula: lea rdx,[rsi+0x140]; movaps xmm7,xmm9 (41 0F 28 F9: xmm7 = raw fraction, exactly as vanilla); xmm0 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=7, out=0)]; movaps xmm9,xmm0 (44 0F 28 C8); jmp site+11. Path A (+0x740=+0x4cc=0, +0x8780..+0x8790=0): xmm9 is final here (clamped rate if +0x720=0, else +0x7f4) and is read afterwards only as the per-frame fraction of [0xf0]<-[0x140] and [0x100]<-[0x150] and [0x120]<-[0x170] (movaps xmm2,xmm9), [0x138]<-[0x188] and [0x130]<-[0x180] (mulss xmm1,xmm9), and by the store at 0x14073bc88 (CAM_BLEND_A_STORE). xmm7 is read again on path A only by that store and by the epilogue call (CAM_BLEND_EPI_SLERP), so both see the raw value; the leaf helpers 0x140265f00/f10/f80, 0x140263e80, 0x1402663a0 and 0x140266730 touch only xmm0-2. xmm0 dead (0x140265f10 writes it before any read); flags dead; rdx preserved by EmitFloatCall. site+0 is a branch target (je at 0x14073bac6); nothing jumps inside. Install together with CAM_BLEND_A_STORE.

name: CAM_BLEND_A_STORE
formula: movss [rsi+0x698],xmm7 (F3 0F 11 BE 98 06 00 00); jmp site+9. Stores the raw fraction: xmm7 equals vanilla xmm9 bit for bit (copied at 0x14073bafa, neither register written afterwards). No registers or flags written. Harmless on its own (vanilla xmm7 == xmm9 here); required whenever CAM_BLEND_A_FINAL is installed.

name: CAM_BLEND_B1_FINAL
formula: addss xmm6,xmm8; xmm2 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=2, out=2)]; xmm3 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=3, out=3)]; xmm6 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=6, out=6)]; jmp site+5. Path B (+0x740=+0x4cc=0, some of +0x8780..+0x8790 set) with +0x228!=0: xmm2/xmm3/xmm6 = p*[0x22c]/[0x230]/[0x210] + (1-p)*rate (p = 1-[0x734]/[0x730], or 1) are final here, never stored, and used only as per-frame fractions: xmm2 for x,z of [0xf0]<-[0x140] and [0x100]<-[0x150], xmm3 for their y, xmm6 for vectors [0x110]<-[0x160] and [0x120]<-[0x170] and scalars [0x130] [0x134] [0x138]. LerpE of the blended fraction, not of each factor. Live across the cave and preserved by EmitFloatCall: xmm0 (=[0xf0]), xmm1 (=[0x140]-[0xf0]), rcx/rdx/r8 (helper args); flags dead. Nothing branches into site+1..+4.

name: CAM_BLEND_B2_FINAL
formula: addss xmm9,xmm0; movaps xmm0,xmm9 (41 0F 28 C1); xmm0 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=0, out=0)]; movaps xmm9,xmm0 (44 0F 28 C8); jmp site+5. Path B with +0x228=0: xmm9 = p*[0x210] + (1-p)*rate is final here, never stored, and used only as the per-frame fraction of [0xf0]<-[0x140] (unless the +0x878c eased override runs), [0x100]<-[0x150] (unless +0x8790), [0x130]/[0x134]/[0x138] (unless +0x8784/+0x8780/+0x8788), [0x110]<-[0x160], [0x120]<-[0x170]. xmm0 dead (written at 0x14073bf83/0x14073bf9f or by 0x140265f10 before any read); flags dead (cmp at site+5).

name: CAM_BLEND_C_F0
formula: movaps xmm0,xmm9 (41 0F 28 C1); xmm0 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=0, out=0)]; movaps xmm9,xmm0 (44 0F 28 C8); lea r14,[rsi+0xf0]; jmp site+7. Path C (+0x740 or +0x4cc set), +0x869c=0: xmm9 = max([0x508], xmm7) (when +0x4cc and +0x504) or xmm7, raw; its only read is movaps xmm2,xmm9 for [0xf0]<-[0x140] at 0x14073c345, and it is reloaded from xmm7 at 0x14073c40b before any later read (not state). xmm7 (the stored value) untouched. xmm0 dead (0x140265f10 writes it), flags dead. site+0 is a branch target (je at 0x14073c312/0x14073c31b); nothing jumps inside.

name: CAM_BLEND_C_100
formula: movaps xmm0,xmm9 (41 0F 28 C1); xmm0 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=0, out=0)]; movaps xmm9,xmm0 (44 0F 28 C8); lea rdi,[rsi+0x100]; jmp site+7. Path C, +0x86a0=0: xmm9 = max([0x508], xmm7) or xmm7 (raw), read only by movaps xmm2,xmm9 for [0x100]<-[0x150] at 0x14073c449 and dead afterwards. xmm7 untouched. xmm0 dead (0x140265f10 writes it), flags dead. site+0 is a branch target (je at 0x14073c416/0x14073c41f); nothing jumps inside.

name: CAM_BLEND_C_138
instruction: subss xmm1, xmm0 ; mulss xmm1, xmm7
formula: subss xmm1,xmm0; xmm2 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=7, out=2)]; mulss xmm1,xmm2 (F3 0F 59 CA); jmp site+8. Path C, +0x8698=0: [0x138] += ([0x188]-[0x138])*f with f = xmm7. xmm7 itself stays raw (stored at 0x14073c67b, passed to 0x14073e4a0). xmm2 dead (next written at 0x14073c55d); xmm0/xmm1 preserved by EmitFloatCall; flags dead.

name: CAM_BLEND_C_120
formula: xmm2 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=7, out=2)]; lea rdx,[rbp-0x19]; jmp site+7. Path C (always): xmm2 is the scale passed to 0x140265f80 in the [0x120]<-[0x170] vector lerp. rcx/r8 preserved, xmm7 unchanged, flags dead.

name: CAM_BLEND_C_130
instruction: subss xmm1, xmm0 ; mulss xmm1, xmm7
formula: subss xmm1,xmm0; xmm2 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=7, out=2)]; mulss xmm1,xmm2 (F3 0F 59 CA); jmp site+8. Path C (always): [0x130] += ([0x180]-[0x130])*f. xmm7 stays raw. xmm2 dead (written at 0x14073c641 or inside 0x140266730 before any read; 0x14073e4a0 does not read xmm2); xmm0/xmm1 preserved; flags dead.

name: CAM_BLEND_EPI_SLERP
instruction: movaps xmm1, xmm7 ; mov rcx, rsi
formula: xmm1 = LerpE [EmitFloatCall(LerpE, in=7, out=1)]; mov rcx,rsi; jmp site+6 (the call 0x14073e4a0). All paths, when +0x724!=0: 0x14073e4a0 (only caller) builds quaternions for the current look direction [0x100]-[0xf0] and the target [0x150]-[0x140], slerps current toward target by t = xmm1 (0x140264db0 at 0x14073e902) and re-places [0xf0] on the orbit, so xmm1 is a per-frame fraction. xmm7 here is the raw fraction on every path (A: copy of the final xmm9; B and the early exit at 0x14073ba9c: clamped rate; C: the value just stored). Still before add rsp (the tail pdata chunk 0x14073c6c6..0x14073c6e3 shares the body frame), so rsp is 16-byte aligned; nonvolatile regs already restored and untouched; flags dead (je at 0x14073c6c4 consumed them).
